title: Feeling Ill
description: Mai is ill and goes to see the doctor.
instructions: Read about Mai's visit to the doctor. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🤒 On Monday morning, Mai did not feel well. She had a headache and a sore throat. She did not want any breakfast.
Her mum took her temperature. It was thirty-eight degrees. 'You have a fever,' said Mum. 'We must go to the doctor.'
They went to the doctor's by taxi. There were five people in the waiting room. Mai read a magazine and waited for twenty minutes.
Dr Green was a kind woman. She looked at Mai's throat and listened to her chest. 'You have a bad cold,' she said.
💊 The doctor gave Mai some medicine. 'Take it twice a day,' she said. 'Drink a lot of water and stay in bed for two days.'
Mai went home and slept all afternoon. In the evening, her friend Anna called her. 'Get well soon!' said Anna. Mai felt a little better.
